The '''Killstick''' was a simple smooth [[Staff/Legends|staff]] of ancient design that was made of wood or a composite of simple alloys. This weapon greatly increased the damage and attack of its wielder.

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, this [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] is available only through the use of a cheat code. Additionally, the killstick has the potential for instant [[Death/Legends|death]] against an opponent.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
